title: Sources: SK Hynix is in talks with Intel to manufacture memory chips in the US, but potential opposition from Seoul could be a major hurdle for the deal (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: SK Hynix is in talks with Intel to manufacture memory chips in the US, but potential opposition from Seoul could be a major hurdle for the deal — South Korea's SK Hynix (000660.KS) is in talks with Intel (INTC.O) about a deal that would see it manufacture memory chips on U.S. soil …
